4.1 Test sample


The test sample includes firms failing to comply with 8-K Item 4 disclosure
requirements disclosed in SEC staff comment letters <sup>14</sup> posted on the EDGAR
website from May 2005 through April 2007 (486 comment letters issued to 418
firms on 8-K Item 4 issues). Table 1 Panel A describes the disposition of the sample.

factors also are causing 8-K Item 4 errors, our corporate governance quality variables should be positively
associated with full disclosure, but bad news auditor-change circumstances should have no explanatory
power.
